title: Kusuri Drinks Her Way Into An Adult Body — Part 3

series.summary: A tall red-haired woman in glasses is leaning over Rentarou in the chemistry room. It is Kusuri, grown up by her own potion, and she is enjoying his panic enormously.

segments.voiceover_text: Something has changed in the chemistry room. A tall woman with dark red hair and glasses leans over Rentarou, and he does not recognize her at all. Then she says his name.
It is Kusuri. Her lab coat is on the floor and her uniform no longer fits her. She grew herself up on purpose, just to watch his reaction.
Rentarou buries his face in the desk, scarlet. Kusuri leans right into him, delighted by every second of his suffering. The potion works. She is enjoying this far too much.
